name: What are the common types of ADUs AKN Design Group constructs?

mainEntity.name: What are the common types of ADUs AKN Design Group constructs?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group specializes in constructing various ADU types, including detached new constructions, garage conversions, and additions to existing homes. We focus on integrating the ADU seamlessly with your property's existing architecture and functionality. Our design-build approach ensures that whether it's a standalone unit or an extension of your primary residence, the new structure meets your specific needs and enhances the overall value of your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group constructs detached ADUs, garage conversions, and home additions to seamlessly integrate with your property.
